name: CleanBee – Hide Admin Notices
author: itbeellc

sections.description:
WP CleanBee Developed by Tamjidul Azam helps administrators keep their WordPress dashboard distraction-free by hiding:

  • Admin notices
  • Plugin/theme promotional banners
  • Update nags

All hidden notices are safely stored and can be reviewed anytime under WP CleanBee → Hidden Notices Log in the admin sidebar.

This ensures you don’t miss important system messages, while still enjoying a clean, professional dashboard.

Features

  • Hide all admin notices and nags
  • Store notices safely for later viewing
  • Dedicated WP CleanBee menu in the sidebar
  • Toggle ON/OFF hiding from settings
  • 100% GPL licensed, no ads or upsells

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wp-cleanbee/ directory, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins screen.
  3. Open WP CleanBee in the sidebar to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Will this hide security or update notices permanently?

No. All notices are captured and displayed in the Hidden Notices Log, so nothing is lost.

Can I turn off the hiding feature?

Yes. Simply uncheck the Hide Admin Notices option on the settings page.

Does WP CleanBee send any data externally?

No. The plugin does not track, log, or transmit any data outside of your WordPress installation.
